tasks.title: Confirm implementation scope and unresolved decisions
steps: Read START_HERE.md, specification.md, project.atmem-ai-architect.json and spec-kit/context.json; summarise the intended outcome in your own words.

Review the existing brief, decisions and spec-kit/questions.md. Reuse answers, recommend routine engineering choices, and consolidate only consequential unresolved business decisions into a small question; record provenance.
Resolve conflicts between requirements, diagram and decisions explicitly. Confirm proposed requirements before treating them as agreed constraints.
Record repository, language/runtime, cloud account owner, environment, country/region and authorization boundaries. Keep unknowns explicit.
outputs: Answered or explicitly deferred questions, with affected tasks identified
acceptance: Confirmed scope and acceptance expectations are recorded.
No proposed requirement or unselected cloud is silently promoted to an agreed decision.

tasks.title: Prepare repository, toolchain and CI
steps: Inspect the destination repository and its instructions before changing files. Preserve existing conventions and useful implementation.

Use the supplied Python 3.13 Linux/amd64 API/worker and isolated parser images. Read terraform/applications/block_696e766f696365/BUILD.md and TESTING.md. Install the exact provider test-requirements.lock in a Linux Python environment or build Dockerfile.tests. Run tests/start-local-fixture.py only against an existing local Unix Docker socket, then tests/run.py with the owned loopback fixture. Keep SDK environments isolated. Do not ask the user to choose a port, command, queue or runtime already implemented here.
Pin dependencies and Terraform/provider versions; configure formatting, linting, unit tests and secret scanning in CI.
Document local setup and use non-secret example configuration. Store secrets in the chosen secret manager or approved environment.
acceptance: A clean checkout can install dependencies and run the documented local checks.
CI executes actual tests and does not require production credentials.

tasks.title: Agree usage assumptions and an initial cost envelope

Identify every proposed billable dimension, including networking, logs, backups, model/embedding requests, third-party licences and one-off delivery effort.
Use dated regional primary prices or quotes where available; show missing rates and currency boundaries without invented totals.
acceptance: Unknown charges remain explicit.
Capacity and cost assumptions are reviewed before service implementation.

tasks.title: Define trust boundaries and deployment units

acceptance: Each trust boundary and physical unit has an owner.

acceptance: Checks run locally without account access.
Schema and mocks are reported independently from account plans and deployed tests.

Separate recurring cloud cost, one-off implementation effort, missing rates and excluded support costs. Agree budgets and alerts.

acceptance: No unpriced component is counted as free.
Cost ranges and assumptions match the intended deployment.

tasks.title: Prove the complete user journey
steps: Exercise the intended outcome: Twenty staff upload PDF invoices up to 10 MB, 500 per day in bursts of twenty. Extract supplier/date/total/currency. Three reviewers approve before the existing accounting system receives an idempotent action. Preserve originals and audit history for 90 days in Australia. Uncertain outcomes and poison work must be recoverable.
Use representative sanitized data and authorized non-production services. Test normal operation, malformed input, denied access and dependency failures.
Run the full acceptance suite and report actual versus expected results, including latency/capacity only where targets were agreed.
Capture reproducible test commands and evidence. Keep failed, skipped and mocked scenarios distinguishable.
acceptance: Each confirmed requirement is covered or has an explicitly accepted unresolved gap.
No mock-only result is reported as proof of a working cloud deployment.

outputs: Observed owned bootstrap and membership/secret-reference acceptance
acceptance: Fresh owned schema and correct restricted roles are evidenced; no unrelated deployment or role was adopted.

steps: Run fixed maintain/monitor tasks and inspect real successful count/status-only receipts. Verify actual native logging destination and existing on-call recipients/delivery.

Observe actual hourly monitor/daily cleanup and inject an approved synthetic failure/missing-run condition. Verify alert evaluation/first-sample or zero-sample behavior and real notification delivery.

Review 90-day access/retention eligibility, object versions, SQL backups and lifecycle lag; exercise the separate isolated restore/reconciliation procedure without replaying uncertain accounting effects.
